tools.name: nfeio_lookup_cnpj
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian company (CNPJ): legal name, trade name, status, main activity and address, from the Receita Federal data. Data key. GET /v2/legalentities/basicInfo/{federalTaxNumber}.

tools.name: nfeio_lookup_state_tax
tools.description: Look up the state tax registration (Inscrição Estadual) of a CNPJ in one state. Data key. GET /v2/legalentities/stateTaxInfo/{state}/{federalTaxNumber}.

tools.name: nfeio_lookup_cep
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian postal code (CEP): street, district, city, state and IBGE city code. Data key. GET /v2/addresses/{postalCode}.

tools.name: nfeio_get_product_invoice
tools.description: Query a product invoice (NF-e) by its 44-digit access key, directly at SEFAZ: issuer, items, totals and status. Data key. GET /v2/productinvoices/{accessKey}.

tools.name: nfeio_list_companies
tools.description: List the active companies (issuers) of this NFe.io account, with their ids and tax numbers. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies.

tools.name: nfeio_get_company
tools.description: Get one company by its NFe.io id or its CNPJ, with registration, municipal tax number and certificate status. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id_or_tax_number}.

tools.name: nfeio_list_service_invoices
tools.description: List the service invoices (NFS-e) of one company, optionally by issue or creation date range. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices.

tools.name: nfeio_get_service_invoice
tools.description: Get one service invoice (NFS-e) by its NFe.io id: status, number, verification code, amounts and borrower. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/{id}.

tools.name: nfeio_get_service_invoice_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one service invoice (NFS-e) by the externalId you sent when issuing it. Invoice key. GET /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/external/{id}.

tools.name: nfeio_issue_service_invoice
tools.description: WRITE, creates a legal service invoice (NFS-e) in the city's tax system for the company. Use only when the user asked to issue it. The call is asynchronous: NFe.io answers 202 and the invoice status becomes final later (check with nfeio_get_service_invoice or nfeio_get_service_invoice_by_external_id

tools.name: nfeio_cancel_service_invoice
tools.description: WRITE, DESTRUCTIVE, cancels a service invoice (NFS-e) at the city's tax system. This cannot be undone and may have tax effects. Use only when the user asked to cancel that invoice. Invoice key. DELETE /v1/companies/{company_id}/serviceinvoices/{id}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nfeio_list_service_invoices, nfeio_issue_service_invoice · Public sink: nfeio_issue_service_invoice · Destructive: nfeio_cancel_service_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nfeio_list_service_invoices, nfeio_issue_service_invoice · Public sink: nfeio_issue_service_invoice · Destructive: nfeio_cancel_service_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
